title: vla.simd: Efficient CPU Inference for Language-Conditioned Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2609.24274v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deploying language-conditioned manipulation without a dedicated GPU requires efficient inference and action chunks that cover the delay between policy queries. We present vla.simd, a CPU inference engine that combines shared SIMD micro-kernels, reusable computation, and target-specific optimization. We relate query latency and execution horizon to action availability under lagged and time-aligned execution, distinguishing action supply from feedback frequency. Across six policies and four CPUs, vla.simd achieves approximately $1.4\times$ median speedup over compiled PyTorch references while preserving fp32 numerical fidelity. We also introduce IMPACT, an ACT-based policy with cached text representations and language-modulated visual features. IMPACT is the only language-conditioned policy in our evaluated set that supplies at least 30 actions/s on the Raspberry Pi 5: after a 90 s thermal soak, it supplies 33.5 actions/s in fp32 and 81.

translated_title: vla.simd：面向语言条件操作任务的高效CPU推理
translated_abstract: 在没有专用GPU的情况下部署语言条件操作需要高效的推理以及能够覆盖策略查询之间延迟的动作块。我们提出了vla.simd，一个结合了共享SIMD微内核、可复用计算和针对特定目标优化的CPU推理引擎。我们将查询延迟和执行视界与滞后执行及时间对齐执行下的动作可用性联系起来，区分了动作供给与反馈频率这两个概念。在六种策略和四种CPU上，vla.simd相比编译后的PyTorch参考实现取得了约1.4倍的中位数加速，同时保持了fp32数值保真度。我们还引入了IMPACT，一种基于ACT的策略，具有缓存的文本表示和语言调制的视觉特征。IMPACT是我们评估的策略集中唯一一种能在树莓派5上提供至少30动作/秒的语言条件策略：在90秒热稳定之后，它以fp32提供33.5动作/秒，81……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出CPU推理引擎vla.simd，通过共享SIMD微内核、可复用计算和目标特定优化，在六种策略和四种CPU上实现约1.4倍中位数加速，并推出基于ACT的IMPACT策略，使其成为唯一能在树莓派5上以fp32提供超过30动作/秒的语言条件操作策略。
en_tdlr: vla.simd is a CPU inference engine combining shared SIMD micro-kernels, reusable computation, and target-specific optimization that achieves ~1.4× median speedup over compiled PyTorch across six policies and four CPUs, and together with the new ACT-based IMPACT policy enables the only language-conditioned policy supplying over 30 actions/s in fp32 on a Raspberry Pi 5.
